chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Abū ʿUbaydah, from one of the two Imams عليهما السلام, who said:
"When you are on a journey, then say: O Allah, make my travel a source of lessons, my silence reflection, and my speech remembrance."

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a form of direct supplication
key_terms.عِبَرًا: lessons, admonitions, or points of reflection
key_terms.مَسِيرِي: my traveling or course of travel

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be said during travel in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited during travel, asking Allah to make the journey spiritually beneficial. It links movement, silence, and speech to moral and devotional states: taking admonition, reflecting, and engaging in dhikr.
